issues.explanation: Draft says Sera knew the code at 11点, but evidence says at 11点 she did not know it.

evidence.excerpt: At 11点 on the same day, Sera had not opened the sealed telegram and did not know its code.

issues.reasoning: The current claim and cited evidence span3 both concern Sera's knowledge of the telegram code at the same stated time, 11点 on the same day. Span3 states she had not opened the sealed telegram and did not know its code, directly contradicting the claim that she knew it. This cannot coexist under the same subject, time, and scope.

suggested_revision.before: At 11点 on the same day, Sera knew the telegram code.
suggested_revision.after: At 11点 on the same day, Sera did not know the telegram code.
